notice: This register covers every image in public/assets/ and brand/public/img/. It holds two different kinds and the "fictional" flag on each entry tells them apart. fictional: true are architectural studies generated through Higgsfield for the concept; never present one as a photograph of an actual listing. fictional: false are real photographs of a real property, supplied by it, and carry their source and rights position. Alt text must state which kind an image is: "Generated concept image." or "Photograph supplied by the property." (docs/23 section 6). fictional: false also covers openly licensed photographs of real places used for destination or mood imagery only (brand/public/img/library/): each carries photographer, source page and licence, and is never shown as a listing photograph (docs/57).

assets.purpose: Homepage feature and Courtyard House
assets.prompt: A modest architect-renovated coastal courtyard house, viewed obliquely from shaded veranda through timber doorway into sunlit courtyard. Pale limewashed brick, weathered timber, olive foliage, one worn chair, linen curtain. Mid-morning raking light, deep olive shadows. Wide architectural magazine composition. Editorial architectural photography, natural restrained colours, realistic scale, straight verticals, tactile materials, subtle film grain, ivory and foliage green palette. No people, no text, no logo, no CGI sheen. Fictional concept property for Porli.

assets.purpose: Courtyard House gallery
assets.prompt: Create a second architectural photograph of the SAME fictional courtyard house in the reference. Maintain its limewashed pale brick, aged oak door frames, stone pavers, olive tree, modest scale and muted warm palette. Camera now stands in the courtyard looking back toward the shaded veranda, a worn timber chair and linen curtain visible. Straight verticals, realistic architecture, understated magazine photograph, natural morning light. No text, people or logos. Match the existing building rather than inventing a different home.

assets.purpose: Courtyard House gallery
assets.prompt: Create a close architectural detail photograph of the SAME fictional courtyard house in the reference. Tight landscape composition of its open weathered timber doorway, pale limewashed masonry and linen curtain, with olive branches casting shadows across the stone threshold. Same materials and restrained daylight, tactile surfaces, natural grain, believable scale. A detail study of the existing reference, not a new room or unrelated house. No text, people, logos.
